children.text: Exercise & Daily Routine
children.cn: 日常锻炼与保持健康

children.text: I do many things in my free time.
children.cn: 我在业余时间做很多事情。
children.notes: in my free time = 在我的空闲时间
children.statement: 本句为题干中预先给出的开头语句。
children.explanation: 题干开头已给出，按规则不计入总词数。

children.text: I exercise every day to keep fit and stay healthy.
children.cn: 我每天锻炼以保持身材和维持健康。
children.notes: keep fit / stay healthy = 保持健康；to exercise 不定式作目的状语
children.statement: 准确运用了提示词 “keep healthy”。
children.explanation: 动词不定式作目的状语说明锻炼的目的。
children.keywords: exercise every day, keep fit, stay healthy

children.text: Taking regular exercise also helps me study better at school.
children.cn: 经常锻炼也有助于我在学校更好地学习。
children.notes: help sb. do sth. = 帮助某人做某事；study better = 更好地学习
children.statement: “Taking regular exercise” 动名词短语作主语，运用了提示词 “study better”。
children.explanation: 动名词作主语，谓语动词用 helps。
children.keywords: regular exercise, helps me, study better

children.text: I like playing basketball, and I often go to the park with my friends to play it.
children.cn: 我喜欢打篮球，我经常和朋友们一起去公园打篮球。
children.notes: play basketball = 打篮球；go to the park = 去公园
children.statement: 运用了提示词 “go to the park”。
children.explanation: 体现了积极的户外体育活动。
children.keywords: playing basketball, go to park, with friends

children.text: Music & Reading
children.cn: 音乐放松与阅读拓展

children.text: I also enjoy listening to music in my bedroom.
children.cn: 我也喜欢在卧室里听音乐。
children.notes: enjoy doing sth. = 喜欢做某事；listen to music = 听音乐
children.statement: 运用了提示词 “listen to music”。
children.explanation: enjoy 后接 listening 动名词。

children.text: Listening to sweet music can make me relax and make me happy.
children.cn: 听动听的音乐可以让我放松，让我开心。
children.notes: make sb. do sth. = 让某人做某事；make sb. + adj. = 让某人处于某种状态
children.statement: 准确运用了提示词 “relax” 和 “make me happy”。
children.explanation: make 后接省略 to 的不定式和形容词作宾补。
children.keywords: music, make me relax, make me happy

children.text: In my spare time, I also enjoy reading all kinds of books.
children.cn: 在空余时间，我也喜欢阅读各类书籍。
children.notes: in my spare time = 在业余时间；all kinds of = 各种各样的
children.explanation: reading books 拓展了课余生活的文化维度。

children.text: It not only opens my eyes, but also increases my knowledge.
children.cn: 它不仅开阔了我的视野，还增长了我的见识。
children.notes: not only... but also... = 不仅……而且……；open one's eyes = 开阔眼界；increase knowledge = 增长知识
children.statement: 准确运用了提示词 “open my eyes” 与 “increase my knowledge”。
children.explanation: 经典并列连词结构强化阅读的积极作用。
children.keywords: not only, opens eyes, but also, increases knowledge

children.text: Weekend & Conclusion
children.cn: 周末活动与总结

children.text: On weekends, I sometimes watch interesting TV programs with my family.
children.cn: 在周末，我有时会和家人一起看有趣的电视节目。
children.notes: on weekends = 在周末；watch TV = 看电视
children.explanation: watch TV 涵盖了提示中的周末家庭活动。
children.keywords: weekends, watch TV programs, with family

children.text: Exercise & Daily Routine
children.cn: 日常锻炼与保持健康

children.text: I do many things in my free time.
children.cn: 我在业余时间做很多事情。
children.notes: in my free time = 在我的空闲时间
children.statement: 本句为题干中预先给出的开头语句。
children.explanation: 题干开头已给出，两篇范文保持完全一致。

children.text: Under the "double reduction" policy, our spare time has greatly increased, which allows me to develop diverse hobbies.
children.cn: 在“双减”政策下，我们的课余时间大大增加了，这使我能够发展多样的爱好。
children.notes: double reduction policy = 双减政策；which 引导非限制性定语从句
children.statement: “which allows me...” 定语从句巧妙切合题干背景。
children.explanation: 紧扣时代政策背景引入课余活动。
children.keywords: double reduction policy, spare time increased, develop hobbies

children.text: First and foremost, I insist on doing physical exercise every day to keep fit and recharge my batteries for better academic performance.
children.cn: 首先，我坚持每天进行体育锻炼以保持体魄健康，并为取得更好的学业成绩积蓄精力。
children.notes: First and foremost = 首先；insist on doing = 坚持做；recharge one's batteries = 积蓄精力
children.statement: “First and foremost” 为高级列举副词短语。
children.explanation: 涵盖 keep fit 与 study better 的升华表达。
children.keywords: First and foremost, physical exercise, keep fit, academic performance

children.text: Whenever the weather is pleasant, I head to the nearby park with my close friends to play energetic basketball matches.
children.cn: 每当天气宜人时，我就会和好友前往附近的公园进行充满活力的篮球比赛。
children.notes: Whenever = 每当（时间状语从句）；head to = 前往；energetic = 充满活力的
children.explanation: 生动刻画了公园打篮球的场景。
children.keywords: Whenever, head to park, close friends, basketball matches

children.text: Music & Reading
children.cn: 音乐放松与阅读拓展

children.text: In addition, immersing myself in melodious music after intense study not only helps me unwind, but also brings immense joy to my heart.
children.cn: 此外，在紧张学习之后沉浸在悦耳的音乐中，不仅有助于我放松身心，还给我的心灵带来极大的快乐。
children.notes: In addition = 此外；immerse oneself in = 沉浸于；unwind = 放松；immense joy = 巨大的快乐
children.statement: “In addition” 增强段落间的逻辑承接。
children.explanation: 动名词短语作主语搭配 Not only... but also... 句型。
children.keywords: In addition, immersing in music, unwind, immense joy
children.highlight: In addition, not only... but also

children.text: Furthermore, reading thought-provoking books is another indispensable pastime that broadens my horizons and enriches my mind.
children.cn: 而且，阅读发人深省的书籍是另一项不可或缺的消遣，它拓宽了我的视野并丰富了我的精神世界。
children.notes: Furthermore = 此外；thought-provoking = 发人深省的；indispensable pastime = 不可或缺的消遣；broaden horizons = 拓宽视野
children.statement: “that broadens...” 定语从句高级替换了 open eyes 和 increase knowledge。
children.explanation: 展现了极为丰富且地道的高阶表达。
children.keywords: Furthermore, reading books, indispensable pastime, broadens horizons

children.text: Weekend & Conclusion
children.cn: 周末活动与总结

children.text: Occasionally on lazy weekend evenings, gathering with my family to watch captivating documentaries brings warmth to our home.
children.cn: 偶尔在慵懒的周末夜晚，与家人聚在一起观看引人入胜的纪录片，给我们的家带来了温暖。
children.notes: Occasionally = 偶尔；captivating documentaries = 吸引人的纪录片
children.statement: “gathering with my family...” 动名词短语作主语。
children.explanation: 温馨呈现周末看电视的家庭时光。
children.keywords: weekend evenings, gathering with family, watch documentaries
